snippet.title: CLIMB IT! - Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3481630/CLIMB_IT/

Climb a colossal mountain, tackling cliffs, ledges, and obstacles. Use skill and agility to navigate a challenging route. Face dangers, make tough calls, and avoid falls from small mistakes. Build adrenaline as you climb, then activate it to slow time for precise jumps and critical moves. Will you conquer the peak?
